purpose: dead-unit parity across geometry arms, before any capacity number is read

settings.clamped_max_dist_rule: 2 x band-top radius of the matched curved arm (hyperbolic diameter is infinite; see _clamped_max_dist)

parity.tolerance_rule: max(0.05, 1/N) — never tighter than one readout unit
parity.verdict_rule: PASS iff >=1 head shows arm-parity within max(0.05, 1/N) in every gated cell and recovers >=90% of features in every arm

parity_all_shapes_decoration.tolerance_rule: max(0.05, 1/N) — never tighter than one readout unit
parity_all_shapes_decoration.verdict_rule: PASS iff >=1 head shows arm-parity within max(0.05, 1/N) in every gated cell and recovers >=90% of features in every arm
